title: Probabilistic Zero Bounds of Certain Random Polynomials
summary: This paper introduces the notion of probabilistic zero bounds for random polynomials. It presents new results regarding the probabilistic bounds of random polynomials whose coefficients are independently and identically distributed as standard normal variates. Additionally, the paper provides a clear exposition of the developed methodology. To establish our results, we develop a novel approach utilizing the classical Cauchy's bounds for the zeros of a deterministic polynomial with complex coefficients.
